benefits_features_and_faqs.about_overview: Marriott Bonvoy HDFC Bank Credit Card is India’s first credit card co-branded with a hotel chain. Offering multiple benefits across Marriott properties worldwide, this card is ideal for Marriott loyalists.
highlights: 1 Free Night Award (up to a value of 15,000 Marriott Bonvoy Points) on levy of joining fee
Complimentary Marriott Bonvoy Silver Elite Status for free (otherwise offered on completing 10 nights a year at Marriott hotels)
10 Elite Night Credits (that can be used for room and membership upgrade) under the Marriott Bonvoy Program for primary cardholder
8 Marriott Bonvoy Points per Rs. 150 spent at hotels participating in Marriott Bonvoy
benefits_features_and_faqs.welcome_benefit: Free Night Stays at Marriott as welcome and milestone benefits
milestone_benefits: 1 Free Night Award on spending 6 lakh in an anniversary year
1 Free Night Award on spending Rs. 9 lakh in an anniversary year
1 Free Night Award on spending Rs. 15 lakh in an anniversary year
dining_benefits: 4 Marriott Bonvoy Points per Rs. 150 spent on travel, dining & entertainment
golf_benefits: 2 complimentary golf access per quarter across the world (Green Fee Waiver)
insurance_cover: Zero lost card liability in case of fraudulent transactions made on the credit card
get_this_card_if: You prefer Marriott and other participating hotels in Marriott Bonvoy for hotel stays
You want luxury hotel benefits at a comparatively affordable fee of Rs. 3,000
You wish to avail lounge access within and outside India
You own other credit cards with additional travel benefits like low forex mark-up, offers with other premium hotels, etc.

faqs.q: What is the benefit of Marriott Bonvoy Silver Elite Status?
faqs.a: Silver Elite is the base membership of the Marriott Bonvoy Loyalty Program. Members get 10% more points on every eligible hotel stay booking, member-only room rates, and other benefits like priority late checkout, complimentary in-room internet access, etc. Though this membership is offered on completing 10 nights per year at participating hotels, you get it complimentary with the Marriott Bonvoy HDFC Bank Credit Card.

faqs.q: Is HDFC Marriott Bonvoy Credit Card worth it?
faqs.a: Since it is a co-branded card, it is perfect for travellers who prefer staying at Marriott Properties. However, consumers who do not wish to limit their benefits to Marriott should consider cards that extend benefits with multiple hotel chains like Axis Reserve or American Express Platinum (Charge) Card.

faqs.q: How can I redeem Marriott Bonvoy Points? What is the value for each point?
faqs.a: Marriott Bonvoy Points can be used to book a stay at select Marriott Properties that are a part of Marriott Bonvoy and Marriott Bonvoy Moments™ experiences. The value you get out of your accumulated MB Points will vary as per the hotel, type of room, booking date, etc.

faqs.q: What are Free Night Awards? How to use them?
faqs.a: Free Night Awards can be considered as free stay vouchers which can be redeemed at the time of booking your stay with participating Marriott properties. If you have Free Night Awards in your Marriott Bonvoy account, it will be preselected at the time of making a booking. You can also combine up to 15,000 MB Points to save more.

faqs.q: Are there any terms and conditions associated with this credit card’s lounge access benefit?
faqs.a: No. there are no spend-based conditions applicable to the lounge access benefit.

faqs.question: Is the Marriott Bonvoy HDFC Bank Credit Card worth it?
faqs.answer: The card is worth considering for regular Marriott travelers because of the Free Night Awards, Silver Elite status, and milestone benefits.

faqs.question: Does the Marriott Bonvoy HDFC Bank Credit Card offer airport lounge access?
faqs.answer: Yes. The card offers 12 domestic and 12 international airport lounge visits per year without any spend-based conditions.

faqs.question: Does the Marriott Bonvoy HDFC Bank Credit Card have spend-based lounge access conditions?
faqs.answer: No. The card currently offers complimentary domestic and international airport lounge access without any spend-based conditions.

faqs.question: What is the annual fee of the Marriott Bonvoy HDFC Bank Credit Card?
faqs.answer: The card has a joining and annual fee of ₹3000 plus GST.

faqs.question: Can Marriott Bonvoy Free Night Awards be topped up with points?
faqs.answer: Yes. Marriott Bonvoy allows users to top up Free Night Awards with up to 25,000 additional Marriott Bonvoy points.
